Expected behaviour:

The required string field will just be shown if the master boolean is set to true.

The master enum field can be used to selectively display a control grid, multi-column section or different sections.

The multi-column section contains an inline and a detached repeat. The inline repeat uses fields with dependencies that can hide inline repeat column cells depending only on the data within the individual row.

The sections contain different repeats for different repeatable groups. The repeats for repeatableGroup1 can be hidden via the checkbox "Hide repeatableGroup1".

The navigation button should always work if the string field is hidden!

The navigation button should not work if the string field is not hidden and empty!
Section with Inline Repeat for repeatableGroup1
Section with Embedded Repeat for repeatableGroup1

Expected behaviour:

If the repeat conains no entries, it should be possible to navigate to another screen.

If the repeat contains filled out entries, it should be possible to navigate to another screen.

If the repeat contains entries, which are not filled out, it should not be possible to navigate to another screen.

Expected behaviour:

If "Enumeration" is set to "yes" and a partial or full validation is triggered, "Date" should show an error, that it is required". If "Enumeration" is than to set "no" the error will still be shown (because only FieldValidation is executed). But as soon as a partial or full validation is triggered, the error should disappear!
Parallel iteration with indexed controls from two repeats
Parallel iteration with indexed controls from two repeats
This example demonstrates a parallel iteration rule for indexed controls from two different repeatable groups. An error should be shown, if they are both filled and contain different values.
This example demonstrates a parallel iteration rule for indexed controls from two different repeatable groups. An error should be shown, if they are both filled and contain different values.

This example demonstrates a rule, which iterates over all rows of a repeatable group. The rule checks, whether the repeatable group contains at least three rows with different values for NumberField.

The rule should be evaluated during a partial validation if the Number Field is visible in all rows of an inline repeat or embedded repeat control grid on the current screen.

The rule should not be evaluated:

  • if the inline repeat and embedded repeat are hidden
  • if NumberField was marked as non-relevant in at least one row
  • on the detached repeat detail screen
Field should not be shown in control-grid and therefore not taken into account when a partial validation is conducted.
